name: modes
description: Voice Control's five recognizer modes. Two are exposed in Settings; three are not.
provenance: Mode names read out of the DictationIM binary on macOS 26.6. Each command opens a two-line shell app that posts the notification. SwiftCodeDictation has its own model (SwiftCodeModel.lzfse) and a ShowCodingUserGuide notification; Apple surfaces neither.
note: Build the wrapper apps first — see docs/apple-internals.md. Scripts and app bundles must NOT live under ~/Library/Application Support (see the TCC trap in that doc).
